scalars.scalar_value: Bachelor’s degree in business administration or liberal arts is preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

A minimum of 2 years of administrative experience with increasing responsibility is preferred. At least 2 years of experience at an academic institution is preferred. At least 2 years of data collection and analysis experience preferred.

The regular hours for this full-time position are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday – Friday. Overtime, holiday, weekend and evening work hours may be required. Travel may be required. Regular hours may vary due to needs of the College or division
